Container.Name: budget
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted budgeting. Plans recurring bills and income by month, tracks what has actually been paid, and projects the bills account forward to show how much can safely leave it today. Requires a PostgreSQL database.
This application has no authentication of its own and is intended to sit behind an authenticating reverse proxy.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty when the container sits on the reverse proxy network and is reached through the proxy.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Local timezone. Governs what today means for due dates and projections.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning files in the data volume.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning files in the data volume.
